sub_answers.sub_question: What is the typical publication pathway from web novel to commercial light novel imprint in Japan?
sub_answers.text: A web novel published on Shōsetsuka ni Narō can be acquired by a publisher that later issues a light novel under a commercial imprint. [d67371034s3p0] Frontier Works began publishing The White Cat's Revenge as Plotted from the Dragon King's Lap under its ArianRose imprint after acquiring it. sub_answers.sub_question: How does a web novel typically get acquired, edited, and released as a commercial light novel (identify the usual steps such as submission, editorial selection, imprinting, and initial print/volume release), and which publishers/imprints most often perform this process?

Which specific writers and isekai franchises demonstrate the pattern of moving from a serialized web novel to later light-novel volumes and broader media outputs (e.g., manga/anime/game), and what evidence shows that progression?
sub_answers.text:
Konoe’s My One-Hit Kill Sister went from Shōsetsuka ni Narō web-serialization (December 2019–June 2023) to a manga serialized on Sunday Webry and Monthly Sunday Gene-X (March 2020–July 2023) and then to an anime aired April–June 2023. [d70280003s0p0]
Kozusu Kobato’s True Love Fades Away When the Contract Ends serialized on Shōsetsuka ni Narō (May 2020–July 2021), received a manga serialization (July 2021–January 2023, then transferred in March 2023), and began a light novel publication under Micro Magazine’s Maple Novels imprint in December 2022. [d79127428s2p0]
Kureha’s The White Cat's Revenge as Plotted from the Dragon King's Lap serialized on Shōsetsuka ni Narō (January 2015–March 2024), was acquired by Frontier Works for light novel publishing under the ArianRose imprint starting October 12, 2016, and also received a manga adaptation serialized on ComicWalker from August 2017. [d79019513s11p0]
kiki’s Roll Over and Die began web-novel serialization on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in January 2018, was acquired for print light-novel releases by Micro Magazine under GC Novels starting July 2018, and also spawned a manga serialized online since December 2018 (with an anime adaptation announced for Jan–Mar 2026). [d67371034s3p0]
